input.command:
python3 -c '
import duckdb, pandas as pd, matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from pathlib import Path
out=Path("out"); out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
df=duckdb.sql("SELECT YEAR(crash_date)::INTEGER AS year, SUM(number_of_motorist_killed)::INTEGER AS motorist_deaths, SUM(number_of_cyclist_killed)::INTEGER AS cyclist_deaths FROM read_parquet(\"data/crashes.parquet\") WHERE YEAR(crash_date) BETWEEN 2013 AND 2025 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1").df()
assert df.year.tolist()==list(range(2013,2026))
df.to_csv(out/"values_1.csv",index=False)
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,5.8))
x=range(len(df)); width=.38
ax.bar([i-width/2 for i in x],df.motorist_deaths,width,label="Motorist deaths",color="#2864A5")
ax.bar([i+width/2 for i in x],df.cyclist_deaths,width,label="Cyclist deaths",color="#E07A2D")
ax.set_xticks(list(x),df.year)
ax.set_ylabel("Deaths per year")
ax.set_title("Motorist and cyclist deaths in NYC, 2013–2025")
ax.legend(frameon=False,ncols=2,loc="upper left")
ax.grid(axis="y",alpha=.25); ax.set_axisbelow(True)
fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(out/"option_1.png",dpi=160); plt.close(fig)
r=df.copy(); r["cyclist_as_pct_motorist"]=(r.cyclist_deaths/r.motorist_deaths*100).round(2)
r.to_csv(out/"values_2.csv",index=False)
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,5.8))
ax.plot(r.year,r.cyclist_as_pct_motorist,marker="o",linewidth=2.4,color="#6F4E9C")
ax.set_xticks(r.year)
ax.set_ylabel("Cyclist deaths as % of motorist deaths")
ax.set_title("Relative cyclist-to-motorist deaths in NYC, 2013–2025")
ax.grid(axis="y",alpha=.3); ax.set_axisbelow(True)
ax.set_ylim(0,max(r.cyclist_as_pct_motorist)*1.2)
fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(out/"option_2.png",dpi=160); plt.close(fig)
print(df.to_string(index=False)); print("\nRelative percentages:\n"+r[["year","cyclist_as_pct_motorist"]].to_string(index=False))
'
